top-n-pair-pre.question: Across all matches, return the 3 distinct name-and-rank combinations of winners with the lowest age recorded for each combination. Output winner name and rank.
top-n-pair-pre.gold_sql: SELECT winner_name, winner_rank FROM (SELECT winner_name, winner_rank, winner_age, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY winner_name, winner_rank ORDER BY winner_age) AS rn FROM matches WHERE winner_age IS NOT NULL) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY winner_age, winner_name, winner_rank LIMIT 3

top-n-pair-post.question: Across all matches, return the 5 distinct name-and-rank combinations of winners with the lowest age recorded for each combination. Output winner name and rank.
top-n-pair-post.gold_sql: SELECT winner_name, winner_rank FROM (SELECT winner_name, winner_rank, winner_age, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY winner_name, winner_rank ORDER BY winner_age) AS rn FROM matches WHERE winner_age IS NOT NULL) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY winner_age, winner_name, winner_rank LIMIT 5

top-n-person-pre.question: Find the 3 youngest distinct individual players to win a match. Return one row per player ID, with the name and rank from their youngest recorded win. If a player has multiple wins at that age, use the earliest tournament date and lowest match number.
top-n-person-pre.gold_sql: SELECT m.winner_name, m.winner_rank FROM matches AS m WHERE m.winner_age IS NOT NULL AND m.rowid = (SELECT a.rowid FROM matches AS a WHERE a.winner_id=m.winner_id AND a.winner_age IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.winner_age, a.tourney_date, a.match_num, a.rowid LIMIT 1) ORDER BY m.winner_age, m.winner_id LIMIT 3
